text: Afua's housewarming is on 14 November. She's finally got the keys to the flat in Walthamstow. I should bring a plant, she said the place feels empty.
Katarzyna's dad passed away last Thursday. The funeral is sometime next week, she'll let me know once it's confirmed. Need to send her a card before then.
Dinner at Deepa and Nikhil's on Saturday. They've asked me to bring dessert. Deepa is vegetarian, Nikhil eats anything.
Marisol told me Dimitri was made redundant on Monday. He hasn't taken it well and is barely leaving the house. I should give him a ring at the end of the week.

Joanna and Kenji have split up. She's moved back in with her mum for now and he's keeping the flat. Feels strange after eight years. Joanna says it was mutual, but Kenji told Marisol a very different story, so I'm keeping out of it. Their joint birthday party on 3rd of December is obviously off now. I'll suggest something low-key with Joanna instead, maybe early next month.
Kate's leaving drinks are on 3rd of December at the Crown. She's off to a new job in Bristol in the new year.
Ioana's grandmother died over the weekend. She flies out to Bucharest on Wednesday for the funeral and will be back around the 28th. Remember to check in with her when she's home.

Heather is throwing a fortieth for her husband Rhys on 12/12. It's a surprise, so not a word. Apparently he'd love a decent bottle of single malt. Heather wants everyone at the restaurant by seven, before he arrives at half past. His brother Bruno is flying in from Lisbon the day before and staying with them, which Rhys thinks is just a casual visit.
Bought the train tickets for Leeds.
Oliver's engagement party has been cancelled. He and Blessing are postponing everything until her dad is out of hospital. He goes in for heart surgery early March.
Krisztina mentioned her brother Aleksander is getting married over the summer, probably in Budapest. She's been asked to give a speech and is already panicking about it.
Beatriz Barros, Bea to everyone at work, is having a birthday lunch on Friday. Don't forget to sign the card that's going round.

Caught up with Kiri after the funeral yesterday. She seemed calmer than I expected, though she admitted the last few weeks have been awful. Her sister Esme is staying with her until the end of the month. I said I'd pop round sometime next week with food, and I meant it. Must actually put it in the diary this time.
Hiroshi's company is announcing redundancies on 20 November. He thinks his whole team is at risk.
Yasmin is hosting Diwali dinner on the 1st. Mariam and Rana are going too. Yasmin is lactose intolerant, so no cheese board this year.
Message Natasha to ask how the memorial went on Sunday.

Pooja's cat Biscuit went missing on Tuesday. She's put posters up all over the estate. Poor thing, she's devastated. Her daughter keeps asking when he's coming home. Pooja's going round the vets and rescue centres tomorrow and again on Saturday. I said I'd share the post in the neighbourhood group tonight, so need to do that before bed.
Anan and his wife are throwing a housewarming early December. Their new place is in Didsbury, near the park. He said the invite would come by WhatsApp.
Haruto got the job at the architecture firm! Starts on 6th of January. We should take him out for a drink to celebrate before Christmas.
Dalia's mum is having her hip replaced on 18 November. Dalia is taking a fortnight off to look after her. Remind me to text Dalia the day after the operation.
Picked up the suit from the dry cleaner. Still need to sort shoes before Saturday.
Bruno told me his parents are separating after thirty-five years. His dad has already moved out. He's trying to stay neutral but it's hard on his younger sister.
Elijah's book club is doing a Christmas dinner sometime in mid December. He invited me along. Need to finish the book first.
I'm doing the cake for Afua's housewarming. Two layers, lemon, nothing fancy.

Spoke to Katarzyna this evening. The funeral is on 29 October at eleven, at the crematorium in Hendon. Her brother Dimitri is flying in from Athens the night before. She asked if I could do a reading. I said yes, obviously, but I'm nervous about getting through it.

Deepa is struggling since the redundancy. She's applying for everything but hearing nothing back. Her partner Kenji is doing extra shifts to cover the mortgage. She has a second interview with a charity on 12 November, the first one in months, and she's terrified of messing it up. I should text her good luck the night before.
Marisol's annual bonfire party is off this year because of the rain. She's doing a small dinner instead on the 8th.
Joanna mentioned that Kate's grandad died on 2 October. The funeral was last week. Kate never said anything to me, so I'll leave it unless she brings it up.
Should send Ioana flowers before the end of the week. She's been through a lot.
Heather and Rhys are celebrating their tenth anniversary on 14/02. They're going to Lisbon for a long weekend.
Oliver's dog Pepper has to be put to sleep. He's taking her to the vet on Thursday morning. He's in pieces about it.
Blessing is starting her new job at the council on 2 December. She's nervous because it's a big step up from her old role.

Krisztina, Aleksander and their cousin Beatriz all came round for dinner. Aleksander is moving to Edinburgh at the end of the month for work. His girlfriend is staying in London for now. Beatriz is training for the Brighton marathon in April and won't shut up about it, which is lovely.
Note to self: Kiri loves anything with lavender. Good for her birthday on 9th of January.
Grabbed a coffee with Esme. She's doing a pottery course on Tuesday evenings and is weirdly good at it.

Hiroshi was let go last Friday. He seemed oddly relieved. He's thinking of taking a few months off and travelling around Japan over the spring before looking for anything new. Ask him sometime next week how the exit paperwork went.
Yasmin's sister Rana is pregnant! Due early June. Yasmin is going to be an auntie for the first time and she's beside herself.
Need to RSVP to Mariam's wedding by 30 November.
Natasha's uncle passed away this morning. She's driving up to Newcastle tonight to be with her aunt. Don't know when the funeral will be yet.
Pooja and Anan are hosting a games night next Friday. I'm bringing crisps and the new version of Codenames.

Haruto mentioned that his mother is coming over from Osaka over Christmas, staying with him until about the 10th of January. First time she's visited since he moved here. He's a bit stressed about her seeing the state of his flat.

Dr Kumar retires at the end of the month. The surgery is having a little send-off for her on 28 November. Should chip in for the leaving present. Mariam from reception is collecting, and she says Dr Kumar has always wanted to learn to paint, so they're thinking of an art class voucher. Her husband is retiring at the same time and they're planning to spend the summer in Kerala.
Aleksander's band is playing the Lexington on 5 December. He said it's their biggest gig so far. I've already bought my ticket.

Dalia broke up with Elijah. Apparently it happened sometime last week but she only told me today. She's okay, she says, but she sounded flat on the phone. He's gone quiet on everyone. I don't want to take sides. I'll invite her for lunch at the weekend and leave him a bit of space. Don't forget to check in with Elijah too, maybe early next week.
Bruno's little girl Esme turns five on 22 November. Party at the soft play in Croydon at two. She's obsessed with dinosaurs at the moment.
Groceries for Sunday: lamb, rosemary, potatoes, mint sauce, wine.
Afua said her dad's memorial is on 17th of November, a year since he passed. Small family thing at the church. I should text her that morning.
Kate's birthday drinks moved from the 15th to the 22nd because half the group had Covid. Same pub.
Joanna is finding the breakup really hard. She can't sleep and keeps going over everything. Her sister Natasha is coming down to stay this weekend, which should help.
Kenji's company has put him on notice of redundancy. Consultation meeting on 4 November. He's quietly hoping for the payout so he can retrain as a teacher.
Rhys mentioned Heather has been dropping hints about a new pair of walking boots. Her birthday's at the end of January.
Dinner at Marisol's was lovely. Her new partner Bruno cooked paella. He's Portuguese, works in finance, and has a very excitable spaniel called Churro.
Remind me to call Ioana on 3rd of November. That's the day she goes back to work after the bereavement leave and she's dreading it.
Deepa invited me to her son's christening sometime in early March. Date to follow.
Katarzyna's funeral reading went okay, I think. Her mum came over afterwards and hugged me for ages. I should message Katarzyna this weekend to see how she's holding up.

Oliver Walsh's dad died on 11/10. The funeral was quiet, family only. Oliver has gone back to work already, which worries me a bit. His girlfriend Blessing says he's not talking about it. Need to take him for a pint sometime this week.
Krisztina's hen do is in Prague from 7 to 9 May. Deposit due by the end of next month.
Beatriz has been offered voluntary redundancy and has until 25 November to decide. She's torn.
Mrs O'Brien next door lost her husband in the summer. She asked if I could help with her garden sometime over the winter. I'll pop round on Saturday.
Haruto and Kiri are throwing a joint thirtieth on 13th of December, somewhere in Shoreditch. Kiri says Haruto has been dropping hints about a record player. Must get them both something.
